guide.prio: Raise a Daze starter (Void Slash) with its Bash finishers (Splitting Slash, Ground Smash) first, then the Confusion pair (Lion's Roar with Gale Slash or Crescent Strike). Most skills get big boosts at Tier 5, 8, 9 and 10.

debuff.name: Daze
debuff.bonus: Void Slash and Body Check Daze for 5s; Splitting Slash and Ground Smash then deal Bash and DMG Boost +50% (Tier 1).

debuff.name: Confusion
debuff.bonus: Lion's Roar Dazes and Confuses for 5s; Gale Slash and Crescent Strike then deal Bash and DMG Boost +50% (Tier 1).

guide.pvp_bonus: Finishers deal Bash and DMG Boost +50% on Dazed (Splitting Slash, Ground Smash) or Confused targets (Gale Slash, Crescent Strike), Tier 1. Lion's Roar cuts enemy PHYS ATK by 80.

guide.prio: The two Chilled starters (Ravaging Blow, Ascending Dragon) and their finishers (Double Strike, Crescent Blade) first, cast by hand. Codex: PHYS ATK and Debilitation success boost so Chilled lands reliably.

debuff.name: Chilled
debuff.bonus: On a Chilled target, Bash is guaranteed and Double Strike deals extra damage. Debilitation success boost (Codex) helps Chilled land.

guide.pvp_bonus: Starters apply Chilled; on Chilled targets Bash always lands and Double Strike deals extra damage. Piercing Spear adds 1 hit near max range.

skills.what: Transformation; at high tiers recovers Vitality while in Asura form.
skills.desc: Through the contract of blood, becomes incarnate of Asura, the lord of hell for a short while. The power of all dark arts become greatly increased.
kx: T8-9: recover 10% Vitality while in Asura form (T10-11: 15%, T12: 20%).

skills.desc: The blue flame in the form of a ghost burns the enemy's soul and body.
The gates of hell shall open, and the eternal pain of the dead shall drag the enemies into the abyss.

skills.what: Area attack; at high tiers a successful Bash adds an MP Cost Boost debuff.
skills.desc: The dark art that summons a Craveling from its den to let it devour everything within the target area.
kx: T8: MP Cost Boost +50% on Bash (T10-11: +100%, T12: +150%).

skills.desc: The forbidden spell that uses dark blood to temporarily wield the power beyond all limits with the outburst of inner demonic aura.

skills.what: Scattering petals; at high tiers lowers Silence resistance on hit.
skills.desc: Those allured by the beautiful blooming of the flowers of death shall soon be split into pieces by the sharp scatter of the petals.
The dark art wields the power of purification in reverse, weakening nearby enemies by decaying the land and air.

skills.what: Hits many enemies and heals you.
skills.desc: The forbidden spell that strikes many enemies with the chains of blood and extorts their blood energy to recover health.
When the Evil Dragon lacerates the earth with its claws, lands will be shattered and nothing will remain.
The absolute curse that leaves the mark of annihilation on the enemy, breaking down the body and soul from the inside.

skills.what: Weakens the target; at high tiers removes part of its MP.
skills.desc: The dark art that forces the energy of the target to flow backward, weakening the target and leaving it vulnerable to attacks.
kx: Removes target MP: 7% (T1-4) up to 42% (T12).
In Asura form: Sanguine Backflow 10s; if the target heals, it takes DMG equal to 30% (T10-12: 40%) of current HP.

skills.desc: The gruesome figure of the devil is summoned to terrify the enemies nearby.

skills.what: Ignores attacks for a moment and confuses enemies.
skills.desc: The dark art that ignores all attacks by transforming the caster's body into a mist. The enemies that inhale the mist fall into a state of confusion, almost as though their spirits were fading away.

guide.note: We have not found a verified Darkist combo or leveling guide yet. Official notes say she is a ranged caster who weakens enemies with curses and poison; Backflow and Decay weaken targets before the damage skills.

items: Extra damage a skill deals when the target already has the debuff it needs. How much depends on the skill and its tier: Warrior finishers get +50% DMG boost on Dazed or Confused targets at Tier 1, and Splitting Slash +80% from Tier 8. Our sources give no figures for the other classes.
Triggers Bash (does not stack). Warrior finishers like Splitting Slash hit harder on Dazed targets.
Movement speed -50%. Triggers Bash, chance to Freeze (stun), DMG boost (max 3 stacks).
A debilitation effect; skills with Bash and DMG Boost on Quelled targets deal extra damage.
Name used in the Korean Taoist guide for the effect from Rain of Blades; Soaring Slash deals extra Bash damage to it. Our English sources do not define it further.
The target falls; keep attacking or move away while it is down.
